data.description:
This update improves the production readiness and security of the portal backend. Key changes include:

API Routing Consistency: Updated the server's catch-all routing to correctly identify and handle requests under the /portal-api/api/ prefix, preventing them from falling back to serving the frontend index.html. This ensures that invalid API calls return a proper JSON 404 response.
Security Hardening: Enhanced the Content Security Policy (CSP) via Helmet. Added upgrade-insecure-requests to the production policy and introduced a more permissive but functional CSP for development to ensure better environment parity.
Test Stability: Fixed a failing test in validate.test.js that was incorrectly asserting on error messages and status codes. Also ensured all necessary backend dependencies are installed for the test suite to run successfully.

Test Stability: Fixed a failing test in validate.test.js that was incorrectly asserting on error messages and status codes. Also ensured all necessary backend dependencies are installed for the test suite to run successfully.

metadata.description:
This update improves the production readiness and security of the portal backend. Key changes include:

API Routing Consistency: Updated the server's catch-all routing to correctly identify and handle requests under the /portal-api/api/ prefix, preventing them from falling back to serving the frontend index.html. This ensures that invalid API calls return a proper JSON 404 response.
Security Hardening: Enhanced the Content Security Policy (CSP) via Helmet. Added upgrade-insecure-requests to the production policy and introduced a more permissive but functional CSP for development to ensure better environment parity.
Test Stability: Fixed a failing test in validate.test.js that was incorrectly asserting on error messages and status codes. Also ensured all necessary backend dependencies are installed for the test suite to run successfully.
